ko.title: 버블인가 호황인가? AI 투자 경쟁이 주식과 당신의 401(k)에 의미하는 것

segments.src: Over the past few years, a small group of technology giants has poured unprecedented sums into artificial intelligence: data centers, advanced chips, power contracts and the engineers to run it all.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년 동안 소수의 기술 거룡들이 인공지능에 전례 없는 막대한 자금을 쏟아부었습니다: 데이터 센터, 첨단 칩, 전력 계약, 그리고 이를 모두 운영할 엔지니어들입니다.

segments.src: That spending has become one of the biggest stories in the market.
segments.tr: 그러한 지출은 시장에서 가장 큰 화두 중 하나가 되었습니다.

segments.src: It has also made a handful of stocks so large that their ups and downs can move the value of ordinary retirement accounts.
segments.tr: 또한 이는 소수의 주식을 너무나 크게 만들어, 그들의 등락이 일반 은퇴 계좌의 가치를 흔들 수 있게 만들었습니다.

segments.src: This article explains what is happening, why analysts disagree about it, and what it could mean for people who save through a 401(k) or an IRA.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 현재 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지, 분석가들이 왜 이에 대해 의견이 갈리는지, 그리고 이것이 401(k)나 IRA를 통해 저축하는 사람들에게 무엇을 의미할 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보일 뿐, 개인화된 투자 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## 지출의 규모

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: 가장 큰 클라우드 및 소프트웨어 기업들은 각각 AI 인프라에 연간 수십억 달러를 투입해 왔으며, 이 그룹 전체의 연간 자본 지출을 합치면 이제 수천억 달러에 달합니다.

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: 이 자금은 주로 다음 곳으로 향합니다:

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **데이터 센터:** AI 모델을 학습하고 실행하는 서버로 가득 찬 대규모 시설.

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **특수 칩:** 주로 소수의 공급업체에서 공급하는 프로세서로, 이에 대한 수요가 해당 공급업체들의 가치를 급격히 끌어올렸습니다.

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **에너지 및 냉각:** 시설을 계속 가동하기 위한 전력 계약, 전력망 업그레이드, 새로운 전력원.

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: - **규제 및 준법:** 인공지능 기술의 발전과 함께 증가하는 법적, 규제적 요구 사항을 충족하기 위한 투자.

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: 이러한 구매는 칩 제조업체, 장비 공급업체, 유틸리티 및 건설 회사로 흘러 들어가기 때문에, 그 영향은 구매를 진행하는 기업들을 훨씬 넘어 확장됩니다.

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: ## 소수의 주식이 그토록 중요한 이유

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: 대부분의 광범위한 미국 주식 지수 펀드는 시가총액 가중 방식으로 구성됩니다.

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: 기업의 주식 시장 가치가 클수록 지수에서 차지하는 비중도 커집니다.

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: 수년간의 강력한 상승세 끝에, 소수의 AI 연계 기업들이 이제 S&P 500과 같은 주요 지수에서 매우 큰 부분을 차지하고 있습니다.

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년 동안 상위 10개 보유 종목이 지수 가치의 대략 3분의 1을 차지했으며, 이는 역사적 기준으로 볼 때 매우 높은 집중도 수준입니다.

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: 이는 이 소수의 주식이 오를 때 전체 지수가 오르며, 그 반대의 경우도 성립함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: "500개의 서로 다른 회사"를 소유하고 있다고 믿는 투자자는 실제로는 그중 소수의 회사에 크게 의존하고 있는 셈입니다.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## 거품이라는 주장의 근거

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: 거품을 지적하는 분석가들은 몇 가지 우려를 제기합니다:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **지출이 매출을 앞지를 수 있습니다.** 고객이 AI 제품에 얼마나 지불할지 불분명한 상황에서 기업들이 막대한 투자를 하고 있습니다. 수익이 예상보다 느리게 들어온다면 지출이 삭감될 수 있으며, 이는 공급업체들에 큰 타격을 줄 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **순환 거래.** 일부 비평가들은 자금이 고리를 그리며 이동한다고 지적합니다. 기업들이 자신의 제품을 구매할 고객에게 투자하는 방식입니다. 이는 수요가 실제보다 더 강해 보이게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **높은 밸류에이션.** 가격이 수년간의 급격한 성장을 가정할 때, 사소한 실망조차 큰 하락을 유발할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **역사적 잔향.** 실제 기술 변화와 나중에 터무니없이 높았던 것으로 판명된 가격이 일치했던 1990년대 후반 닷컴 시대와의 비교가 종종 이루어집니다.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## 지속 가능한 변화라는 주장의 근거

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 이번에는 더 탄탄한 기반 위에 있다고 주장합니다:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **실제 이익.** 많은 닷컴 시대 기업들과 달리, 오늘의 리더들은 지출의 대부분을 자체 현금 흐름으로 충당하는 대규모의 수익성 있는 기업들입니다.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **가시적인 수요.** 클라우드 제공업체들은 컴퓨팅 용량에 대한 수요가 때때로 공급을 초과했다고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **광범위한 채택.** 의료, 금융, 물류, 소프트웨어 등 전 분야의 기업들이 AI 도구를 테스트하거나 배포하고 있으며, 이는 시간이 지남에 따라 생산성을 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **기술적 선례.** 철도나 인터넷과 같은 과거의 범용 기술들도 심각한 과잉 투자를 겪었지만, 장기적으로는 경제를 재편했습니다.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: 두 진영 모두 부분적으로는 옳을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: 기술은 혁신적이면서도 단기적으로는 고평가될 수 있으며, 조정이 온다고 해서 근본적인 변화가 실패했다는 뜻은 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## 이것이 당신의 401(k)에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: 대부분의 근로자는 개별 주식을 고르지 않습니다.

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: 그들은 은퇴 계획에서 타겟데이트 펀드, 인덱스 펀드 또는 기타 분산 투자 옵션을 보유합니다.

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: 이러한 펀드들은 종종 대형주 중심의 미국 지수를 추종하므로, 위에서 설명한 집중 현상이 자동으로 동반됩니다.

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: - **타겟데이트 펀드**는 일반적으로 미국 주식의 비중을 높게 보유하며, 이는 동일한 선도 기업들에 대한 상당한 노출을 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **S&P 500 및 전체 시장 지수 펀드**는 규모에 따라 가중치가 부여되므로 가장 큰 이름들이 가장 큰 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **중복은 쉽게 간과될 수 있습니다.** 각각 대형 미국 기업을 추종하는 여러 펀드를 보유하는 것은 동일한 소수의 주식에 대한 노출을 줄이기보다는 오히려 증가시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: 따라서 이러한 선도 주식의 급격한 하락은 투자자가 직접 해당 주식을 전혀 구매하지 않았더라도 은퇴 잔액에 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: 젊은 저축자들은 경기 침체에서 회복할 시간이 있습니다.

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: 은퇴에 가까운 사람들은 시간이 부족하며, 이것이 타이밍과 자산 배분이 중요한 이유입니다.

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: ## 고려해야 할 실용적인 포인트

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: 이 중 어느 것도 패닉에 빠지거나 악명 높게 어려운 시장 타이밍을 맞추려고 시도해야 할 이유는 아닙니다.

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: 하지만 자문해 볼 만한 합리적인 질문들은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: 1. **내가 무엇을 소유하고 있는지 확인하세요.** 대부분의 플랜 웹사이트에는 펀드의 상위 보유 종목이 나열되어 있습니다. 가장 큰 기업들에 얼마나 많은 자금이 들어가 있는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 2. **다산성을 살펴보세요.** 혼자 움직이지 않는 채권, 해외 주식, 소형주 및 기타 영역이 당신의 자산 배분에 포함되어 있는지 고려하세요.

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 3. **위험을 타임라인에 맞추세요.** 돈이 필요할 때가 가까울수록, 큰 하락폭이 더 큰 타격을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 4. **주기적으로 리밸런싱을 하세요.** 한 영역의 강력한 상승은 의도하지 않게 포트폴리오를 원래의 혼합 상태에서 멀어지게 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 5. **꾸준히 기여를 유지하세요.** 시간에 따른 정기적인 기여는 서로 다른 가격에 구매하는 효과를 부드럽게 만들어 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 6. **필요한 경우 도움을 요청하세요.** 면허를 가진 재무 어드바이저나 플랜의 교육 자원이 당신의 상황에 맞게 선택을 조정하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: AI 투자 경쟁은 지속적인 경제적 변화, 과도한 호황, 혹은 두 가지의 혼합으로 판명될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: 아무도 확실히 알지 못하며, 양방향으로의 자신감 넘치는 예측은 경계해야 합니다.

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.
segments.tr: 분명한 것은 시장 집중도가 높으며, 이를 선택한 적이 없는 많은 은퇴 저축자들에게 영향을 미친다는 점입니다.

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.
segments.tr: 펀드가 무엇을 보유하고 있는지 이해하는 것은 이야기의 결말이 어떻게 되든 실용적인 첫걸음입니다.

segments.src: Understanding what your funds hold is a practical first step, whichever way the story ends.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 투자, 세무 또는 법적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Investing involves risk, including possible loss of principal.
segments.tr: 과거의 실적이 미래의 결과를 보장하지 않습니다.*

zh.title: 泡沫还是繁荣？人工智能支出竞赛对股票和您的 401(k) 意味着什么

segments.src: Over the past few years, a small group of technology giants has poured unprecedented sums into artificial intelligence: data centers, advanced chips, power contracts and the engineers to run it all.
segments.tr: 在过去几年里，一小群科技巨头在人工智能领域投入了前所未有的资金：数据中心、先进芯片、电力合同以及运营这一切所需的工程师。

segments.src: That spending has become one of the biggest stories in the market.
segments.tr: 这种支出已成为市场上最大的新闻之一。

segments.src: It has also made a handful of stocks so large that their ups and downs can move the value of ordinary retirement accounts.
segments.tr: 它还使得少数几只股票变得如此庞大，以至于它们的涨跌足以影响普通退休账户的价值。

segments.src: This article explains what is happening, why analysts disagree about it, and what it could mean for people who save through a 401(k) or an IRA.
segments.tr: 本文将解释正在发生的事情、分析师为何对此存在分歧，以及这对通过 401(k) 或 IRA 进行储蓄的人们意味着什么。

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: 本文仅供参考，并非个性化的投资建议。

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## 支出的规模

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: 最大的云服务和软件公司每年都在向人工智能基础设施投入数百亿美元，该行业集团的年度资本支出总额目前已达数千亿美元。

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: 这些资金主要流向：

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **数据中心：** 装满服务器的大型设施，用于训练和运行人工智能模型。

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **专用芯片：** 处理器，主要来自少数几家供应商，其需求已大幅提升了这些供应商的估值。

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **能源和冷却：** 电力合同、电网升级和新的电力来源，以维持设施的运行。

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: 由于这些采购流向了芯片制造商、设备供应商、公用事业公司和建筑公司，其影响范围远远超出了进行采购的公司本身。

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: ## 为什么少数几只股票如此重要

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: 大多数广泛的美国

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: 股票指数基金是按市值加权的。

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: 一家公司的股票市值越大，它在指数中所占的份额就越大。

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: 经过多年的强劲增长，少数几家与人工智能相关的公司现在在标普 500 等主要指数中占据了非常大的比例。

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: 近年来，前十大持仓股约占指数价值的三分之一，这种集中度按历史标准来看是非常高的。

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: 这意味着当这几只股票上涨时，整个指数也会上涨，反之亦然。

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: 一位认为自己拥有“500 家不同公司”的投资者，实际上是在重仓其中的少数几家公司。

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## 泡沫论的观点

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: 看到泡沫的分析师指出了几个担忧：

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **支出可能超过收入。** 在客户愿意为人工智能产品支付多少费用尚不明确的情况下，公司正在进行大量投资。如果回报到来的速度慢于预期，支出可能会被削减，从而严重打击供应商。

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **循环交易。** 一些批评人士指出，资金在循环流动，公司投资于客户，而客户随后又购买它们的产品。这可能使需求看起来比实际更强劲。

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **高估值。** 当价格假设未来几年会有快速增长时，即使是轻微的失望也可能导致大幅下跌。

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **历史回响。** 人们经常将其与 20 世纪 90 年代末的互联网泡沫时代进行比较，当时真正的技术变革伴随着后来被证明过高的价格。

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## 持久转型论的观点

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: 另一些人则认为这次的基础更稳固：

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **真正的利润。** 与许多互联网泡沫时代的公司不同，今天的领导者是大型、盈利的企业，它们利用自身的现金流为大部分支出提供资金。

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **可见的需求。** 云服务提供商报告称，对计算能力的需求有时已经超过了供应。

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **广泛的采用。** 医疗保健、金融、物流和软件等行业的企业正在测试或部署人工智能工具，这可能会随着时间的推移提高生产力。

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **技术先例。** 过去的通用技术，如铁路和互联网，也经历了严重的过度建设，但从长远来看，它们重塑了经济。

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: 双方可能都有部分道理。

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: 一项技术可以是变革性的，但在短期内仍可能被高估，而调整并不意味着潜在的变革失败。

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## 这如何影响您的 401(k)

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: 大多数员工不会挑选个股。

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: 他们在退休计划中持有目标日期基金、指数基金或其他多元化选择。

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: 这些基金通常追踪美国大盘股

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: 指数，因此上述的集中度会自动随之而来。

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **目标日期基金**通常持有很大比例的美国股票，这意味着对同样的领先公司有显著的敞口。

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **标普 500 和全市场指数基金**按规模加权，因此最大的公司名称具有最大的影响力。

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: - **重叠很容易被忽视。** 持有几只各自追踪美国大公司股票的基金，可能会增加而不是减少对这少数几只股票的敞口。

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: 因此，即使投资者从未直接购买过这些领先股票，它们的急剧下跌也可能反映在退休余额中。

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: 年轻的储蓄者有时间从低迷中恢复。

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: 接近退休的人时间较少，这就是为什么时机和组合很重要的原因。

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## 需要考虑的实际要点

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: 这些都不是恐慌或试图把握市场时机的理由，因为这众所周知是非常困难的。

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: 但有一些明智的问题值得一问：

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **检查您的持仓。** 大多数计划网站都会列出基金的前几大持仓。看看最大的公司占了多少比例。

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **查看多元化。** 考虑您的组合是否包括债券、国际股票、小型公司以及其他与大型科技股不同步的领域。

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **将风险与您的时间表相匹配。** 您越接近需要用钱的时间，大幅回调造成的伤害就越大。

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **定期重新平衡。** 某一领域的强劲收益可能会悄悄地使您的投资组合偏离预期的组合。

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **保持稳定投入。** 随着时间的推移进行定期投入可以平滑在不同价格购买的影响。

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **如有需要，寻求帮助。** 持牌财务顾问或您计划的教育资源可以帮助根据您的情况量身定制选择。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: 人工智能支出竞赛可能被证明是一种持久的经济转型、一种过度扩张的繁荣，或者是两者的某种混合。

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.
segments.tr: 没有人能确定，对任何方向的自信预测都应保持谨慎。

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.
segments.tr: 显而易见的是，市场集中度很高，而且它影响了许多从未选择过这种集中度的退休储蓄者。

segments.src: Understanding what your funds hold is a practical first step, whichever way the story ends.
segments.tr: 无论故事如何收场，了解您的基金持有什么是务实的第一步。

segments.tr: 投资涉及风险，包括可能损失本金。

segments.tr: 过去的业绩并不保证未来的结果。*

hi.title: बबल या बूम? AI खर्च की दौड़ का शेयरों और आपके 401(k) के लिए क्या मतलब है

segments.src: Over the past few years, a small group of technology giants has poured unprecedented sums into artificial intelligence: data centers, advanced chips, power contracts and the engineers to run it all.
segments.tr: पिछले कुछ वर्षों में, प्रौद्योगिकी दिग्गजों के एक छोटे से समूह ने आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस में अभूतपूर्व राशि खर्च की है: डेटा सेंटर, उन्नत चिप्स, बिजली अनुबंध और इस सब को चलाने के लिए इंजीनियर।

segments.src: That spending has become one of the biggest stories in the market.
segments.tr: यह खर्च बाजार की सबसे बड़ी कहानियों में से एक बन गया है।

segments.src: It has also made a handful of stocks so large that their ups and downs can move the value of ordinary retirement accounts.
segments.tr: इसने कुछ शेयरों को इतना बड़ा भी बना दिया है कि उनके उतार-चढ़ाव आम सेवानिवृत्ति खातों के मूल्य को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: This article explains what is happening, why analysts disagree about it, and what it could mean for people who save through a 401(k) or an IRA.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि क्या हो रहा है, विश्लेषक इस पर असहमत क्यों हैं, और उन लोगों के लिए इसका क्या मतलब हो सकता है जो 401(k) या IRA के माध्यम से बचत करते हैं।

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, व्यक्तिगत निवेश सलाह नहीं।

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## खर्च का पैमाना

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: सबसे बड़ी क्लाउड और सॉफ्टवेयर कंपनियां AI बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए हर साल अरबों डॉलर प्रतिबद्ध कर रही हैं, और पूरे समूह में संयुक्त वार्षिक पूंजी खर्च अब सैकड़ों अरबों में मापा जाता है।

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: पैसा मुख्य रूप से जाता है:

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **डेटा सेंटर:** सर्वर से भरी विशाल सुविधाएं जो AI मॉडल को प्रशिक्षित करती हैं और चलाती हैं।

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **विशेष चिप्स:** प्रोसेसर, ज्यादातर आपूर्तिकर्ताओं की एक छोटी संख्या से, जिनकी मांग ने उन आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के मूल्यांकन को तेजी से बढ़ाया है।

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **ऊर्जा और शीतलन:** सुविधाओं को चालू रखने के लिए बिजली अनुबंध, ग्रिड अपग्रेड और नए बिजली स्रोत।

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: क्योंकि ये खरीदारी चिप निर्माताओं, उपकरण आपूर्तिकर्ताओं, उपयोगिताओं और निर्माण फर्मों तक बहती है, इसका प्रभाव खरीदारी करने वाली कंपनियों से बहुत आगे तक फैलता है।

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: ## कुछ शेयर इतने महत्वपूर्ण क्यों हैं

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: अधिकांश व्यापक U.S.

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: स्टॉक इंडेक्स फंड बाजार पूंजीकरण द्वारा भारित होते हैं।

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: कंपनी का शेयर बाजार मूल्य जितना बड़ा होगा, सूचकांक में उसका हिस्सा उतना ही बड़ा होगा।

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: वर्षों के मजबूत लाभ के बाद, AI से जुड़ी कंपनियों की एक छोटी संख्या अब S&P 500 जैसे प्रमुख सूचकांकों का एक बहुत बड़ा हिस्सा बनाती है।

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में, शीर्ष दस होल्डिंग्स का सूचकांक के मूल्य में लगभग एक तिहाई हिस्सा रहा है, जो कि ऐतिहासिक मानकों के अनुसार उच्च एकाग्रता का स्तर है।

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह है कि जब वे कुछ शेयर बढ़ते हैं, तो पूरा सूचकांक बढ़ता है, और इसका उल्टा भी सच है।

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: एक निवेशक जो मानता है कि उनके पास "500 विभिन्न कंपनियां" हैं, वह व्यावहारिक रूप से उनमें से कुछ की भारी खुराक प्राप्त कर रहा है।

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## मामला कि यह एक बुलबुला (बबल) है

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: झाग (froth) देखने वाले विश्लेषक कई चिंताओं की ओर इशारा करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **खर्च राजस्व से आगे निकल सकता है।** कंपनियां भारी निवेश कर रही हैं, इससे पहले कि यह स्पष्ट हो कि ग्राहक AI उत्पादों के लिए कितना भुगतान करेंगे। यदि रिटर्न उम्मीद से अधिक धीमा आता है, तो खर्च में कटौती की जा सकती है, जिससे आपूर्तिकर्ताओं पर भारी असर पड़ेगा।

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **सर्कुलर सौदे।** कुछ आलोचकों का कहना है कि पैसा लूप में चलता है, कंपनियां उन ग्राहकों में निवेश करती हैं जो फिर उनके उत्पाद खरीदते हैं। इससे मांग जितनी है उससे ज्यादा मजबूत दिख सकती है।

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **उच्च मूल्यांकन।** जब कीमतें वर्षों की तेजी से वृद्धि मान लेती हैं, तो मामूली निराशा भी बड़ी गिरावट का कारण बन सकती है।

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **ऐतिहासिक अनुगूंज।** तुलना अक्सर 1990 के दशक के उत्तरार्ध के डॉट-कॉम युग से की जाती है, जब वास्तविक तकनीक परिवर्तन उन कीमतों के साथ हुआ जो बाद में बहुत अधिक साबित हुईं।

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: - ## मामला कि यह एक टिकाऊ बदलाव है

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: दूसरों का तर्क है कि इस बार मामला मजबूत नींव पर टिका है:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **वास्तविक लाभ।** डॉट-कॉम युग की कई फर्मों के विपरीत, आज के नेता बड़े, लाभदायक व्यवसाय हैं जो अपने खर्च का अधिकांश हिस्सा अपने स्वयं के नकद प्रवाह से वित्तपोषित करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **दृश्यमान मांग।** क्लाउड प्रदाताओं ने रिपोर्ट दी है कि कंप्यूटिंग क्षमता की मांग कभी-कभी आपूर्ति से अधिक हो गई है।

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **व्यापक रूप से अपनाना।** स्वास्थ्य सेवा, वित्त, रसद और सॉफ्टवेयर में व्यवसाय AI उपकरणों का परीक्षण या तैनाती कर रहे हैं, जो समय के साथ उत्पादकता बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **प्रौद्योगिकी की मिसाल।** रेलमार्ग और इंटरनेट जैसी पिछली सामान्य-उद्देश्यीय प्रौद्योगिकियों ने भी भारी अति-निर्माण देखा, फिर भी लंबे समय में अर्थव्यवस्था को नया रूप दिया।

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्ष आंशिक रूप से सही हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: एक तकनीक परिवर्तनकारी हो सकती है और फिर भी अल्पावधि में अधिक कीमत वाली हो सकती है, और सुधार का मतलब यह नहीं है कि अंतर्निहित परिवर्तन विफल हो जाता है।

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## यह आपके 401(k) तक कैसे पहुंचता है

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: अधिकांश कर्मचारी व्यक्तिगत शेयर नहीं चुनते हैं।

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: वे अपनी सेवानिवृत्ति योजनाओं में टारगेट-डेट फंड, इंडेक्स फंड या अन्य विविध विकल्प रखते हैं।

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: वे फंड अक्सर बड़े कैप U.S.

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: सूचकांकों को ट्रैक करते हैं, इसलिए ऊपर वर्णित एकाग्रता अपने आप आती है।

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **टार्गेट-डेट फंड** आमतौर पर U.S. शेयरों का एक बड़ा हिस्सा रखते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है उन्हीं अग्रणी कंपनियों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण जोखिम।

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **S&P 500 और कुल बाजार सूचकांक फंड** आकार के आधार पर भारित होते हैं, इसलिए सबसे बड़े नामों का सबसे बड़ा प्रभाव होता है।

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: - **ओवरलैप को चूकना आसान है।** कई फंड रखना जो प्रत्येक बड़ी U.S. कंपनियों को ट्रैक करते हैं, उन्हीं कुछ शेयरों के जोखिम को कम करने के बजाय बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: इसलिए उन अग्रणी शेयरों में तेज गिरावट सेवानिवृत्ति शेष में दिखाई दे सकती है, भले ही निवेशक ने उनमें से किसी को सीधे न खरीदा हो।

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: कम उम्र के बचतकर्ताओं के पास मंदी से उबरने का समय है।

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: सेवानिवृत्ति के करीब के लोगों के पास कम समय है, यही वजह है कि समय और मिश्रण मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## विचार करने योग्य व्यावहारिक बिंदु

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: इनमें से कोई भी घबराने या बाजार का समय तय करने का प्रयास करने का कारण नहीं है, जो कुख्यात रूप से कठिन है।

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: लेकिन पूछने के लिए समझदारी भरे सवाल हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **जांचें कि आपके पास क्या है।** अधिकांश योजना वेबसाइटें एक फंड की शीर्ष होल्डिंग्स को सूचीबद्ध करती हैं। देखें कि सबसे बड़ी कंपनियों में कितना है।

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **विविधता पर ध्यान दें।** विचार करें कि क्या आपके मिश्रण में बॉन्ड, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय शेयर, छोटी कंपनियां और अन्य क्षेत्र शामिल हैं जो बड़ी तकनीक के साथ कदम से कदम मिलाकर नहीं चलते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **अपनी समयसीमा से जोखिम का मिलान करें।** आप पैसे की आवश्यकता के जितने करीब होंगे, उतनी ही अधिक बड़ी गिरावट नुकसान पहुंचा सकती है।

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **समय-समय पर रीबैलेंस करें।** एक क्षेत्र में मजबूत लाभ चुपचाप आपके पोर्टफोलियो को उसके इच्छित मिश्रण से दूर कर सकता है।

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **लगातार योगदान करते रहें।** समय के साथ नियमित योगदान विभिन्न कीमतों पर खरीदने के प्रभाव को सुचारू बना सकता है।

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **यदि आवश्यक हो तो मदद मांगें।** एक लाइसेंस प्राप्त वित्तीय सलाहकार या आपकी योजना के शैक्षिक संसाधन आपकी स्थिति के अनुसार विकल्पों को तैयार करने में मदद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य बात

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: AI खर्च की दौड़ एक स्थायी आर्थिक बदलाव, एक अत्यधिक विस्तारित बूम, या दोनों का कुछ मिश्रण साबित हो सकती है।

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.
segments.tr: कोई निश्चित रूप से नहीं जानता, और किसी भी दिशा में आश्वस्त भविष्यवाणियां सावधानी की पात्र हैं।

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.
segments.tr: जो स्पष्ट है वह यह है कि बाजार की एकाग्रता अधिक है, और यह कई सेवानिवृत्ति बचतकर्ताओं को प्रभावित करती है जिन्होंने इसे कभी नहीं चुना।

segments.src: Understanding what your funds hold is a practical first step, whichever way the story ends.
segments.tr: यह समझना कि आपके फंड क्या रखते हैं, एक व्यावहारिक पहला कदम है, चाहे कहानी किसी भी तरह से समाप्त हो।

es.title: ¿Burbuja o bonanza? Lo que la carrera del gasto en IA significa para las acciones y su plan 401(k)

segments.src: Over the past few years, a small group of technology giants has poured unprecedented sums into artificial intelligence: data centers, advanced chips, power contracts and the engineers to run it all.
segments.tr: Durante los últimos años, un pequeño grupo de gigantes tecnológicos ha vertido sumas sin precedentes en inteligencia artificial: centros de datos, chips avanzados, contratos de energía y los ingenieros para administrarlo todo.

segments.src: That spending has become one of the biggest stories in the market.
segments.tr: Ese gasto se ha convertido en una de las historias más grandes del mercado.

segments.src: It has also made a handful of stocks so large that their ups and downs can move the value of ordinary retirement accounts.
segments.tr: También ha hecho que un puñado de acciones sea tan grande que sus altibajos pueden mover el valor de las cuentas de jubilación ordinarias.

segments.src: This article explains what is happening, why analysts disagree about it, and what it could mean for people who save through a 401(k) or an IRA.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica lo que está sucediendo, por qué los analistas no están de acuerdo al respecto y qué podría significar para las personas que ahorran a través de un 401(k) o una IRA.

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento de inversión personalizado.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## La escala del gasto

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: Las empresas más grandes de nube y software han estado comprometiendo cada una decenas de miles de millones de dólares al año en infraestructura de IA, y el gasto de capital anual combinado en todo el grupo se mide ahora en cientos de miles de millones.

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: El dinero se destina principalmente a:

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **Centros de datos:** instalaciones masivas llenas de servidores que entrenan y ejecutan modelos de IA.

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **Chips especializados:** procesadores, en su mayoría de un pequeño número de proveedores, cuya demanda ha elevado drásticamente las valoraciones de esos proveedores.

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **Energía y refrigeración:** contratos de electricidad, actualizaciones de la red y nuevas fuentes de energía para mantener las instalaciones en funcionamiento.

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: Debido a que estas compras fluyen hacia los fabricantes de chips, proveedores de equipos, empresas de servicios públicos y firmas de construcción, el efecto se extiende mucho más allá de las empresas que realizan las compras.

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: ## Por qué unas pocas acciones importan tanto

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los fondos de índices bursátiles de EE. UU.

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: amplios ponderan por capitalización bursátil.

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: Cuanto mayor sea el valor de mercado de las acciones de una empresa, mayor será su participación en el índice.

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: Después de años de fuertes ganancias, un pequeño número de empresas vinculadas a la IA representa ahora una porción muy grande de los principales índices como el S&P 500.

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, las diez principales participaciones han representado aproximadamente un tercio del valor del índice, un nivel de concentración alto para los estándares históricos.

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: Esto significa que cuando esas pocas acciones suben, todo el índice sube, y lo contrario también es cierto.

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: Un inversor que cree que posee "500 empresas diferentes" está, en la práctica, recibiendo una gran dosis de solo unas pocas de ellas.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## El argumento de que es una burbuja

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: Los analistas que ven espuma señalan varias preocupaciones:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **El gasto puede superar a los ingresos.** Las empresas están invirtiendo fuertemente antes de que esté claro cuánto pagarán los clientes por los productos de IA. Si los rendimientos llegan más lentamente de lo esperado, el gasto podría recortarse, afectando duramente a los proveedores.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **Acuerdos circulares.** Algunos críticos señalan que el dinero se mueve en bucles, con empresas invirtiendo en clientes que luego compran sus productos. Eso puede hacer que la demanda parezca más fuerte de lo que es.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **Valoraciones altas.** Cuando los precios asumen años de rápido crecimiento, incluso una modesta decepción puede causar grandes caídas.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **Ecos históricos.** Se hacen comparaciones a menudo con la era dot-com de finales de la década de 1990, cuando un cambio tecnológico real coincidió con precios que más tarde demostraron ser demasiado altos.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## El argumento de que es un cambio duradero

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: Otros sostienen que esta vez se apoya en terreno más firme:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Ganancias reales.** A diferencia de muchas empresas de la era dot-com, los líderes de hoy son negocios grandes y rentables que financian gran parte de su gasto con su propio flujo de caja.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **Demanda visible.** Los proveedores de nube han informado que la demanda de capacidad de cómputo a veces ha superado la oferta.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **Adopción amplia.** Las empresas en los sectores de salud, finanzas, logística y software están probando o implementando herramientas de IA, lo que podría aumentar la productividad con el tiempo.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **Precedente tecnológico.** Las tecnologías pasadas de uso general, como los ferrocarriles e internet, también vieron una sobreconstrucción masiva, pero remodelaron la economía a largo plazo.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: Ambos bandos pueden tener parte de razón.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: Una tecnología puede ser transformadora y seguir estando sobrevalorada a corto plazo, y una corrección no significa que el cambio subyacente falle.

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## Cómo llega esto a su 401(k)

segments.tr: La mayoría de los trabajadores no eligen acciones individuales.

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: Mantienen fondos de fecha objetivo, fondos de índice u otras opciones diversificadas en sus planes de jubilación.

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: Esos fondos a menudo siguen a los índices de gran capitalización de EE. UU.

segments.tr: - **Los fondos de fecha objetivo** típicamente mantienen una gran parte de acciones de EE. UU., lo que significa una exposición significativa a las mismas empresas líderes.

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **Los fondos de índice S&P 500 y de mercado total** se ponderan por tamaño, por lo que los nombres más grandes tienen la mayor influencia.

segments.tr: - **La superposición es fácil de pasar por alto.** Mantener varios fondos que siguen cada uno a grandes empresas de EE. UU. puede aumentar, en lugar de reducir, la exposición al mismo puñado de acciones.

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, una caida pronunciada en esas acciones líderes podría verse reflejada en el saldo de jubilación incluso si el inversor nunca compró ninguna de ellas directamente.

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: Los ahorradores más jóvenes tienen tiempo para recuperarse de las recesiones.

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: Las personas cercanas a la jubilación tienen menos, por lo que el momento oportuno y la mezcla importan.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Puntos prácticos a considerar

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: Nada de esto es una razón para entrar en pánico o tratar de adivinar el mercado, lo cual es notoriamente difícil.

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: Pero hay preguntas sensatas que hacer:

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **Compruebe lo que posee.** La mayoría de los sitios web de los planes enumeran las principales participaciones de un fondo. Vea cuánto se encuentra en las empresas más grandes.

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **Observe la diversificación.** Considere si su mezcla incluye bonos, acciones internacionales, empresas más pequeñas y otras áreas que no se mueven al mismo ritmo que las grandes tecnológicas.

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **Adapte el riesgo a su cronograma.** Cuanto más cerca esté de necesitar el dinero, más puede perjudicar una gran reducción.

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **Reequilibre periódicamente.** Las fuertes ganancias en un área pueden empujar silenciosamente a su cartera fuera de su mezcla prevista.

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **Siga contribuyendo de forma constante.** Las contribuciones regulares a lo largo del tiempo pueden suavizar el efecto de comprar a diferentes precios.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **Pida ayuda si la necesita.** Un asesor financiero con licencia o los recursos educativos de su plan pueden ayudar a adaptar las opciones a su situación.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: La carrera del gasto en IA puede resultar ser un cambio económico duradero, un auge sobredimensionado o una mezcla de ambos.

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.

ar.title: فقاعة أم طفرة؟ ماذا يعني سباق الإنفاق على الذكاء الاصطناعي بالنسبة للأسهم وحسابات التقاعد 401(k)

segments.src: Over the past few years, a small group of technology giants has poured unprecedented sums into artificial intelligence: data centers, advanced chips, power contracts and the engineers to run it all.
segments.tr: على مدى السنوات القليلة الماضية، ضخت مجموعة صغيرة من عمالقة التكنولوجيا مبالغ غير مسبوقة في الذكاء الاصطناعي: مراكز البيانات، والرقائق المتقدمة، وعقود الطاقة، والمهندسين لتشغيل كل ذلك.

segments.src: That spending has become one of the biggest stories in the market.
segments.tr: أصبح هذا الإنفاق أحد أكبر القصص في السوق.

segments.src: It has also made a handful of stocks so large that their ups and downs can move the value of ordinary retirement accounts.
segments.tr: كما جعل حفنة من الأسهم كبيرة جداً لدرجة أن تقلباتها يمكن أن تؤثر على قيمة حسابات التقاعد العادية.

segments.src: This article explains what is happening, why analysts disagree about it, and what it could mean for people who save through a 401(k) or an IRA.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال ما يحدث، ولماذا يختلف المحللون حوله، وما يمكن أن يعنيه للأشخاص الذين يدخرون من خلال حساب 401(k) أو حساب التقاعد الفردي (IRA).

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة، وليست نصيحة استثمارية مخصصة.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## حجم الإنفاق

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: التزمت أكبر شركات السحابة والبرمجيات بإنفاق عشرات المليارات من الدولارات سنوياً على البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي، ويُقاس إجمالي الإنفاق الرأسمالي السنوي للمجموعة الآن بمئات المليارات.

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: تذهب الأموال بشكل رئيسي إلى:

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **مراكز البيانات:** مرافق ضخمة مليئة بالخوادم التي تدرب نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وتشغلها.

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **الرقائق المتخصصة:** معالجات، معظمها من عدد صغير من الموردين، أدى الطلب عليها إلى رفع تقييمات هؤلاء الموردين بشكل حاد.

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **الطاقة والتبريد:** عقود الكهرباء، وتحديثات الشبكة، ومصادر الطاقة الجديدة للحفاظ على تشغيل المرافق.

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: ولأن هذه المشتريات تتدفق إلى صانعي الرقائق، وموردي المعدات، والمرافق، وشركات البناء، فإن التأثير يمتد إلى ما هو أبعد من الشركات التي تقوم بالشراء.

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: ## لماذا تعتبر بعض الأسهم مهمة جداً

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: معظم صناديق مؤشرات الأسهم الأمريكية الواسعة

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: مرجحة حسب القيمة السوقية.

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: كلما زادت القيمة السوقية للشركة، زادت حصتها في المؤشر.

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: بعد سنوات من المكاسب القوية، أصبح عدد صغير من الشركات المرتبطة بالذكاء الاصطناعي يشكل الآن جزءاً كبيراً جداً من المؤشرات الرئيسية مثل S&P 500.

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: في السنوات الأخيرة، استحوذت أكبر عشر شركات في المؤشر على ما يقرب من ثلث قيمته، وهو مستوى من التركيز يعتبر مرتفعاً وفقاً للمعايير التاريخية.

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: هذا يعني أنه عندما ترتفع تلك الأسهم القليلة، يرتفع المؤشر بأكمله، والعكس صحيح أيضاً.

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: المستثمر الذي يعتقد أنه يمتلك "500 شركة مختلفة" يحصل في الواقع على جرعة كبيرة من عدد قليل منها.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## الحجة القائلة بأنها فقاعة

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: يشير المحللون الذين يرون وجود فقاعة إلى عدة مخاوف:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **قد يتجاوز الإنفاق الإيرادات.** تستثمر الشركات بكثافة قبل أن يتضح مقدار ما سيدفعه العملاء مقابل منتجات الذكاء الاصطناعي. إذا جاءت العوائد أبطأ مما كان مأمولاً، فقد يتم خفض الإنفاق، مما يضر بالموردين بشدة.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **الصفقات الدائرية.** يلاحظ بعض النقاد أن الأموال تتحرك في حلقات، حيث تستثمر الشركات في العملاء الذين يشترون بعد ذلك منتجاتهم. يمكن أن يجعل ذلك الطلب يبدو أقوى مما هو عليه في الواقع.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **التقييمات المرتفعة.** عندما تفترض الأسعار سنوات من النمو السريع، فإن خيبة الأمل البسيطة يمكن أن تسبب انخفاضات كبيرة.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **أصداء تاريخية.** غالباً ما تُعقد مقارنات مع عصر الدوت كوم في أواخر التسعينيات، عندما تزامن التغيير التكنولوجي الحقيقي مع أسعار تبين لاحقاً أنها مرتفعة للغاية.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## الحجة القائلة بأنها تحول دائم

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: يجادل آخرون بأن هذه المرة تستند إلى أرضية أكثر صلابة:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **أرباح حقيقية.** على عكس العديد من شركات عصر الدوت كوم، فإن قادة اليوم هم شركات كبيرة ومربحة تمول جزءاً كبيراً من إنفاقها من تدفقاتها النقدية الخاصة.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **طلب مرئي.** أفاد مقدمو الخدمات السحابية أن الطلب على القدرة الحوسبية تجاوز في بعض الأحيان العرض.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **اعتماد واسع النطاق.** تختبر الشركات في مجالات الرعاية الصحية والتمويل والخدمات اللوجستية والبرمجيات أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي أو تنشرها، مما قد يرفع الإنتاجية بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **سابقة تكنولوجية.** شهدت تقنيات الأغراض العامة السابقة، مثل السكك الحديدية والإنترنت، أيضاً بناءً مفرطاً، ومع ذلك أعادت تشكيل الاقتصاد على المدى الطويل.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: كلا المعسكرين قد يكونان محقين جزئياً.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون التكنولوجيا تحويلية ومع ذلك تكون مبالغاً في سعرها على المدى القصير، والتصحيح لا يعني فشل التغيير الأساسي.

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## كيف يصل هذا إلى حساب التقاعد 401(k) الخاص بك

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: معظم العمال لا يختارون أسهماً فردية.

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: إنهم يحتفظون بصناديق تاريخ الاستهداف، أو صناديق المؤشرات، أو خيارات متنوعة أخرى في خطط تقاعدهم.

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتبع تلك الصناديق مؤشرات الأسهم الأمريكية

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: ذات رأس المال الكبير، لذا فإن التركيز الموصوف أعلاه يحدث تلقائياً.

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **صناديق تاريخ الاستهداف** تحتفظ عادةً بحصة كبيرة من الأسهم الأمريكية، مما يعني تعرضاً كبيراً لنفس الشركات الرائدة.

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **صناديق مؤشر S&P 500 وإجمالي السوق** مرجحة حسب الحجم، لذا فإن أكبر الأسماء لها التأثير الأكبر.

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: - **من السهل تفويت التداخل.** قد يؤدي الاحتفاظ بعدة صناديق تتبع كل منها شركات أمريكية كبيرة إلى زيادة التعرض لنفس الحفنة من الأسهم، بدلاً من تقليله.

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: وبالتالي، يمكن أن يظهر انخفاض حاد في تلك الأسهم الرائدة في رصيد التقاعد حتى لو لم يشترِ المستثمر أياً منها بشكل مباشر.

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: لدى المدخرين الأصغر سناً الوقت للتعافي من فترات الركود.

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: الأشخاص القريبون من التقاعد لديهم وقت أقل، ولهذا السبب يهم التوقيت والمزيج.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## نقاط عملية يجب مراعاتها

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: لا شيء من هذا سبب للذعر أو لمحاولة توقيت السوق، وهو أمر صعب للغاية.

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: ولكن هناك أسئلة منطقية يجب طرحها:

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **تحقق مما تمتلكه.** تدرج معظم مواقع الخطط الاستثمارية أكبر ممتلكات الصندوق. انظر كم يتركز في أكبر الشركات.

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **انظر إلى التنويع.** فكر فيما إذا كان مزيجك يتضمن سندات، وأسهماً دولية، وشركات أصغر، ومجالات أخرى لا تتحرك بالتوازي مع التكنولوجيا الكبيرة.

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **طابق المخاطر مع جدولك الزمني.** كلما اقتربت من الحاجة إلى المال، زاد الضرر الذي يمكن أن يسببه انخفاض كبير.

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **أعد التوازن بشكل دوري.** يمكن للمكاسب القوية في مجال واحد أن تدفع محفظتك بهدوء بعيداً عن المزيج المقصود.

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **استمر في المساهمة بثبات.** يمكن للمساهمات المنتظمة بمرور الوقت أن تخفف من تأثير الشراء بأسعار مختلفة.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **اطلب المساعدة إذا لزم الأمر.** يمكن لمستشار مالي مرخص أو الموارد التعليمية لخطة التقاعد الخاصة بك المساعدة في تكييف الخيارات مع وضعك.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: قد يثبت سباق الإنفاق على الذكاء الاصطناعي أنه تحول اقتصادي دائم، أو طفرة مبالغ فيها، أو مزيج من الاثنين.

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.
segments.tr: لا أحد يعرف على وجه اليقين، والتنبؤات الواثقة في أي من الاتجاهين تستحق الحذر.

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.
segments.tr: ما هو واضح هو أن تركيز السوق مرتفع، وأنه يؤثر على العديد من مدخري التقاعد الذين لم يختاروا ذلك أبداً.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## L'argument selon lequel il s'agit d'une bulle

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: Les analystes qui perçoivent une surchauffe soulignent plusieurs préoccupations :

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **Les dépenses pourraient dépasser les revenus.** Les entreprises investissent massivement avant qu'il ne soit clair combien les clients paieront pour les produits d'IA. Si les rendements arrivent plus lentement que prévu, les dépenses pourraient être réduites, touchant durement les fournisseurs.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **Accords circulaires.** Certains critiques soulignent que l'argent circule en boucle, les entreprises investissant dans des clients qui achètent ensuite leurs produits. Cela peut donner une impression de demande plus forte qu'elle ne l'est.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **Fortes valorisations.** Lorsque les prix supposent des années de croissance rapide, même une déception modeste peut provoquer de fortes chutes.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **Échos historiques.** Des comparaisons sont souvent faites avec l'ère des dot-com de la fin des années 1990, où un changement technologique réel a coïncidé avec des prix qui se sont avérés bien trop élevés par la suite.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## L'argument selon lequel il s'agit d'un changement durable

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: D'autres soutiennent que cette fois-ci repose sur des bases plus solides :

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Vrais bénéfices.** Contrairement à de nombreuses entreprises de l'ère dot-com, les leaders d'aujourd'hui sont de grandes entreprises rentables qui financent une grande partie de leurs dépenses à partir de leur propre flux de trésorerie.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **Demande visible.** Les fournisseurs de cloud ont signalé que la demande en capacité de calcul a parfois dépassé l'offre.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **Large adoption.** Des entreprises de la santé, de la finance, de la logistique et des logiciels testent ou déploient des outils d'IA, ce qui pourrait accroître la productivité au fil du temps.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **Précédent technologique.** Les technologies à usage général du passé, telles que les chemins de fer et Internet, ont également connu une surconstruction importante, tout en remodelant l'économie à long terme.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: Les deux camps peuvent avoir en partie raison.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: Une technologie peut être transformatrice tout en étant surévaluée à court terme, et une correction ne signifie pas que le changement sous-jacent échoue.

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## Comment cela atteint votre 401(k)

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: La plupart des travailleurs ne choisissent pas des actions individuelles.

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: Ils détiennent des fonds à date cible, des fonds indiciels ou d'autres options diversifiées dans leurs plans de retraite.

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: Ces fonds suivent souvent les grands indices

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: boursiers américains, de sorte que la concentration décrite ci-dessus s'applique automatiquement.

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **Les fonds à date cible** détiennent généralement une part importante d'actions américaines, ce qui implique une exposition significative aux mêmes entreprises de premier plan.

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **Le S&P 500 et les fonds indiciels du marché total** sont pondérés par leur taille, de sorte que les plus grands noms ont la plus grande influence.

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: - **Le chevauchement est facile à manquer.** Détenir plusieurs fonds qui suivent chacun de grandes entreprises américaines peut augmenter, plutôt que réduire, l'exposition à la même poignée d'actions.

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: Une baisse brutale de ces actions de premier plan pourrait donc se refléter dans un solde de retraite même si l'investisseur n'en a jamais acheté directement.

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: Les épargnants plus jeunes ont le temps de se remettre des replis.

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: Ceux qui approchent de la retraite en ont moins, c'est pourquoi le timing et la composition comptent.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Points pratiques à considérer

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela n'est une raison de paniquer ou d'essayer de chronométrer le marché, ce qui est notoirement difficile.

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: Mais il y a des questions sensées à se poser :

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifiez ce que vous possédez.** La plupart des sites Web de plans listent les principales participations d'un fonds. Voyez quelle part est investie dans les plus grandes entreprises.

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **Examinez la diversification.** Considérez si votre composition inclut des obligations, des actions internationales, de plus petites entreprises et d'autres secteurs qui ne bougent pas de concert avec la grande technologie.

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **Adaptez le risque à votre horizon temporel.** Plus vous êtes près d'avoir besoin de l'argent, plus un important repli peut faire mal.

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **Rééquilibrez périodiquement.** De fortes hausses dans un secteur peuvent discrètement éloigner votre portefeuille de sa composition prévue.

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **Continuez à cotiser régulièrement.** Des cotisations régulières au fil du temps peuvent lisser l'effet d'achats à différents prix.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **Demandez de l'aide si nécessaire.** Un conseiller financier agréé ou les ressources pédagogiques de votre plan peuvent vous aider à adapter vos choix à votre situation.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: La course aux dépenses en IA pourrait s'avérer être un changement économique durable, un boom surétendu, ou un mélange des deux.

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.

segments.src: Understanding what your funds hold is a practical first step, whichever way the story ends.
