segments.tr: Artikel ini menjelaskan apa yang sedang terjadi, mengapa para analis tidak sepakat mengenai hal ini, dan apa artinya bagi orang-orang yang menabung melalui 401(k) atau IRA.

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan saran investasi yang dipersonalisasi.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## Skala pengeluaran

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: Perusahaan cloud dan perangkat lunak terbesar masing-masing telah mengalokasikan puluhan miliar dolar per tahun untuk infrastruktur AI, dan gabungan belanja modal tahunan di seluruh grup kini diukur dalam ratusan miliar.

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: Uang tersebut terutama digunakan untuk:

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **Pusat data:** fasilitas besar yang dipenuhi server yang melatih dan menjalankan model AI.

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **Chip khusus:** prosesor, sebagian besar dari sejumlah kecil pemasok, yang permintaannya telah meningkatkan valuasi pemasok tersebut secara tajam.

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **Energi dan pendinginan:** kontrak listrik, peningkatan jaringan, dan sumber daya baru untuk menjaga fasilitas tetap berjalan.

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: Karena pembelian ini mengalir ke pembuat chip, pemasok peralatan, utilitas, dan perusahaan konstruksi, dampaknya menyebar jauh melampaui perusahaan yang melakukan pembelian.

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: ## Mengapa beberapa saham sangat penting

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar indeks saham A.S. yang luas

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: diberi bobot berdasarkan kapitalisasi pasar.

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: Semakin besar nilai pasar saham suatu perusahaan, semakin besar pula pangsanya dalam indeks.

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: Setelah bertahun-tahun mengalami keuntungan yang kuat, sejumlah kecil perusahaan yang terkait dengan AI kini mencakup porsi yang sangat besar dari indeks utama seperti S&P 500.

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, sepuluh kepemilikan teratas telah menyumbang sekitar sepertiga dari nilai indeks, tingkat konsentrasi yang tinggi menurut standar historis.

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: Ini berarti ketika beberapa saham tersebut naik, seluruh indeks naik, dan sebaliknya juga benar.

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: Seorang investor yang percaya bahwa mereka memiliki "500 perusahaan berbeda" sebenarnya, dalam praktiknya, mendapatkan porsi besar dari beberapa perusahaan saja.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## Argumen bahwa ini adalah gelembung

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: Analis yang melihat adanya gelembung menunjukkan beberapa kekhawatiran:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **Pengeluaran mungkin melebihi pendapatan.** Perusahaan berinvestasi besar-besaran sebelum jelas berapa banyak pelanggan akan membayar untuk produk AI. Jika keuntungan datang lebih lambat dari yang diharapkan, pengeluaran dapat dipotong, yang akan memukul pemasok dengan keras.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **Transaksi melingkar.** Beberapa kritikus mencatat bahwa uang bergerak dalam lingkaran, dengan perusahaan berinvestasi pada pelanggan yang kemudian membeli produk mereka. Hal itu dapat membuat permintaan terlihat lebih kuat dari yang sebenarnya.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **Valuasi tinggi.** Ketika harga mengasumsikan pertumbuhan pesat selama bertahun-tahun, kekecewaan kecil pun dapat menyebabkan penurunan besar.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **Gema historis.** Perbandingan sering dibuat dengan era dot-com akhir 1990-an, ketika perubahan teknologi yang nyata bertepatan dengan harga yang kemudian terbukti terlalu tinggi.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## Argumen bahwa ini adalah pergeseran yang tahan lama

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: Yang lain berpendapat bahwa kali ini didasarkan pada landasan yang lebih kuat:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Keuntungan nyata.** Tidak seperti banyak perusahaan era dot-com, para pemimpin saat ini adalah bisnis besar yang menguntungkan yang mendanai sebagian besar pengeluaran mereka dari arus kas mereka sendiri.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **Permintaan yang terlihat.** Penyedia cloud telah melaporkan bahwa permintaan untuk kapasitas komputasi terkadang melebihi pasokan.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **Adopsi luas.** Bisnis di seluruh layanan kesehatan, keuangan, logistik, dan perangkat lunak sedang menguji atau menerapkan alat AI, yang dapat meningkatkan produktivitas dari waktu ke waktu.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **Preseden teknologi.** Teknologi tujuan umum di masa lalu, seperti kereta api dan internet, juga mengalami pembangunan berlebihan yang besar, namun membentuk kembali ekonomi dalam jangka panjang.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: Kedua kubu bisa jadi benar sebagian.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: Sebuah teknologi bisa bersifat transformatif namun tetap dinilai terlalu tinggi dalam jangka pendek, dan koreksi tidak berarti perubahan mendasar tersebut gagal.

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana ini mencapai 401(k) Anda

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: Kebanyakan pekerja tidak memilih saham individu.

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: Mereka memegang dana target-date, dana indeks, atau opsi terdiversifikasi lainnya dalam rencana pensiun mereka.

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: Dana tersebut sering melacak indeks A.S.

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: berkapitalisasi besar, sehingga konsentrasi yang dijelaskan di atas terjadi secara otomatis.

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **Dana target-date** biasanya memegang porsi besar saham A.S., yang berarti eksposur signifikan terhadap perusahaan-perusahaan terkemuka yang sama.

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **Dana indeks S&P 500 dan total pasar** diberi bobot berdasarkan ukuran, sehingga nama-nama terbesar memiliki pengaruh paling besar.

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: - **Tumpang tindih mudah terlewatkan.** Memegang beberapa dana yang masing-masing melacak perusahaan besar A.S. dapat meningkatkan, alih-alih mengurangi, eksposur ke segelintir saham yang sama.

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, penurunan tajam pada saham-saham terkemuka tersebut dapat muncul dalam saldo pensiun meskipun investor tidak pernah membelinya secara langsung.

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: Penabung yang lebih muda memiliki waktu untuk pulih dari penurunan.

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: Orang yang mendekati masa pensiun memiliki waktu lebih sedikit, itulah sebabnya waktu dan campuran investasi itu penting.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Poin praktis untuk dipertimbangkan

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: Tidak ada dari hal ini yang menjadi alasan untuk panik atau mencoba mengatur waktu pasar, yang sangat sulit dilakukan.

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: Namun ada pertanyaan masuk akal untuk diajukan:

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **Periksa apa yang Anda miliki.** Sebagian besar situs web rencana mencantumkan kepemilikan teratas dana. Lihat berapa banyak yang ada di perusahaan terbesar.

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **Lihat diversifikasi.** Pertimbangkan apakah campuran Anda mencakup obligasi, saham internasional, perusahaan yang lebih kecil, dan area lain yang tidak bergerak seiring dengan teknologi besar.

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **Sesuaikan risiko dengan garis waktu Anda.** Semakin dekat Anda membutuhkan uang tersebut, semakin besar kerugian yang dapat ditimbulkan oleh penurunan besar.

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **Lakukan penyeimbangan kembali secara berkala.** Keuntungan yang kuat di satu area dapat secara diam-diam mendorong portofolio Anda menjauh dari campuran yang dimaksudkan.

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **Terus berkontribusi dengan stabil.** Kontribusi reguler dari waktu ke waktu dapat memperlancar efek pembelian pada harga yang berbeda.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **Minta bantuan jika diperlukan.** Penasihat keuangan berlisensi atau sumber daya pendidikan rencana Anda dapat membantu menyesuaikan pilihan dengan situasi Anda.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: Perlombaan belanja AI mungkin terbukti menjadi pergeseran ekonomi yang bertahan lama, ledakan yang berlebihan, atau campuran dari keduanya.

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang tahu pasti, dan prediksi yang yakin ke arah mana pun patut diwaspadai.

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.
segments.tr: Yang jelas adalah bahwa konsentrasi pasar tinggi, dan itu memengaruhi banyak penabung pensiun yang tidak pernah memilihnya.

segments.src: Understanding what your funds hold is a practical first step, whichever way the story ends.
segments.tr: Memahami apa yang dipegang dana Anda adalah langkah pertama yang praktis, ke mana pun cerita ini berakhir.

de.title: Blase oder Boom? Was das KI-Ausgabenrennen für Aktien und Ihre Altersvorsorge bedeutet

segments.src: Over the past few years, a small group of technology giants has poured unprecedented sums into artificial intelligence: data centers, advanced chips, power contracts and the engineers to run it all.
segments.tr: In den vergangenen Jahren hat eine kleine Gruppe von Technologieriesen beispiellose Summen in künstliche Intelligenz investiert: Rechenzentren, fortschrittliche Chips, Stromverträge und die Ingenieure, um das alles zu betreiben.

segments.src: That spending has become one of the biggest stories in the market.
segments.tr: Diese Ausgaben sind zu einer der größten Geschichten am Markt geworden.

segments.src: It has also made a handful of stocks so large that their ups and downs can move the value of ordinary retirement accounts.
segments.tr: Sie hat zudem eine Handvoll Aktien so groß gemacht, dass deren Auf und Ab den Wert gewöhnlicher Altersvorsorgekonten beeinflussen kann.

segments.src: This article explains what is happening, why analysts disagree about it, and what it could mean for people who save through a 401(k) or an IRA.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erklärt, was passiert, warum Analysten sich darüber uneinig sind und was es für Menschen bedeuten könnte, die über eine 401(k) oder einen IRA sparen.

segments.src: It is general information, not personalized investment advice.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich um allgemeine Informationen, nicht um eine personalisierte Anlageberatung.

segments.src: ## The scale of the spending
segments.tr: ## Das Ausmaß der Ausgaben

segments.src: The largest cloud and software companies have each been committing tens of billions of dollars a year to AI infrastructure, and combined annual capital spending across the group is now measured in the hundreds of billions.
segments.tr: Die größten Cloud- und Softwareunternehmen haben jeweils Dutzende Milliarden Dollar pro Jahr in die KI-Infrastruktur gesteckt, und die kombinierten jährlichen Kapitalausgaben der Gruppe belaufen sich mittlerweile auf Hunderte Milliarden.

segments.src: The money goes mainly to:
segments.tr: Das Geld fließt hauptsächlich in:

segments.src: - **Data centers:** massive facilities packed with servers that train and run AI models.
segments.tr: - **Data centers:** massive Anlagen voller Server, die KI-Modelle trainieren und betreiben.

segments.src: - **Specialized chips:** processors, mostly from a small number of suppliers, whose demand has lifted those suppliers' valuations sharply.
segments.tr: - **Specialized chips:** Prozessoren, meist von einer kleinen Anzahl von Anbietern, deren Nachfrage die Bewertungen dieser Anbieter stark angetrieben hat.

segments.src: - **Energy and cooling:** electricity contracts, grid upgrades and new power sources to keep the facilities running.
segments.tr: - **Energy and cooling:** Stromverträge, Netz-Upgrades und neue Stromquellen, um die Anlagen am Laufen zu halten.

segments.src: Because these purchases flow to chipmakers, equipment suppliers, utilities and construction firms, the effect spreads well beyond the companies doing the buying.
segments.tr: Da diese Käufe an Chiphersteller, Ausrüstungslieferanten, Versorger und Bauunternehmen fließen, breitet sich der Effekt weit über die kaufenden Unternehmen hinaus aus.

segments.src: ## Why a few stocks matter so much
segments.tr: ## Warum ein paar Aktien so wichtig sind

segments.src: Most broad U.S.
segments.tr: Die meisten breiten US-

segments.src: stock index funds are weighted by market capitalization.
segments.tr: Aktienindexfonds sind nach Marktkapitalisierung gewichtet.

segments.src: The bigger a company's stock market value, the larger its share of the index.
segments.tr: Je größer der Börsenwert eines Unternehmens, desto größer ist sein Anteil am Index.

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: Nach Jahren starker Gewinne machen eine kleine Anzahl KI-verknüpfter Unternehmen nun einen sehr großen Teil wichtiger Indizes wie dem S&P 500 aus.

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: In den letzten Jahren machten die zehn größten Beteiligungen grob ein Drittel des Indexwerts aus, ein Konzentrationsniveau, das nach historischen Maßstäben hoch ist.

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, dass, wenn diese wenigen Aktien steigen, der gesamte Index steigt, und umgekehrt.

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: Ein Investor, der glaubt, er besitze "500 verschiedene Unternehmen", erhält in der Praxis eine kräftige Dosis von einigen wenigen davon.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## Das Argument, dass es eine Blase ist

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: Analysten, die Überhitzung sehen, verweisen auf mehrere Bedenken:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Unternehmen investieren massiv, bevor klar ist, wie viel Kunden für KI-Produkte zahlen werden. Wenn Renditen langsamer als erhofft eintreffen, könnten die Ausgaben gekürzt werden, was Zulieferer hart trifft.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **Circular deals.** Einige Kritiker merken an, dass sich Geld im Kreis bewegt, wobei Unternehmen in Kunden investieren, die dann ihre Produkte kaufen. Das kann die Nachfrage stärker erscheinen lassen, als sie ist.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **High valuations.** Wenn Preise jahrelanges schnelles Wachstum voraussetzen, können selbst bescheidene Enttäuschungen große Rücksetzer verursachen.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **Historical echoes.** Es werden oft Vergleiche zur Dotcom-Ära der späten 1990er Jahre gezogen, als echter technologischer Wandel mit Preisen zusammenfiel, die sich später als viel zu hoch erwiesen.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## Das Argument, dass es ein dauerhafter Wandel ist

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: Andere argumentieren, dass dieses Mal auf einem solideren Fundament ruht:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Real profits.** Im Gegensatz zu vielen Unternehmen der Dotcom-Ära sind die heutigen Spitzenreiter große, profitable Unternehmen, die einen Großteil ihrer Ausgaben aus dem eigenen Cashflow finanzieren.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **Visible demand.** Cloud-Anbieter haben berichtet, dass die Nachfrage nach Rechenkapazität zeitweise das Angebot überstiegen hat.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **Broad adoption.** Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Gesundheitswesen, Finanzen, Logistik und Software testen oder implementieren KI-Tools, was die Produktivität im Laufe der Zeit steigern könnte.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **Technology precedent.** Frühere Mehrzwecktechnologien wie Eisenbahnen und das Internet verzeichneten ebenfalls starke Überkapazitäten, formten die Wirtschaft aber langfristig neu.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: Beide Lager können teilweise recht haben.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: Eine Technologie kann transformativ sein und kurzfristig dennoch überbewertet sein, und eine Korrektur bedeutet nicht, dass die zugrunde liegende Veränderung scheitert.

segments.src: After years of strong gains, a small number of AI-linked companies now make up a very large portion of major indexes such as the S&P 500.
segments.tr: Sau nhiều năm tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ, một số ít công ty có liên quan đến AI hiện chiếm phần lớn trong các chỉ số chính như S&P 500.

segments.src: In recent years, the top ten holdings have accounted for roughly a third of the index's value, a level of concentration that is high by historical standards.
segments.tr: Trong những năm gần đây, mười cổ phiếu nắm giữ hàng đầu chiếm khoảng một phần ba giá trị của chỉ số, mức độ tập trung cao theo tiêu chuẩn lịch sử.

segments.src: This means that when those few stocks rise, the whole index rises, and the reverse is also true.
segments.tr: Điều này có nghĩa là khi những cổ phiếu ít ỏi đó tăng giá, toàn bộ chỉ số sẽ tăng, và điều ngược lại cũng đúng.

segments.src: An investor who believes they own "500 different companies" is, in practice, getting a heavy dose of a few of them.
segments.tr: Một nhà đầu tư tin rằng họ sở hữu "500 công ty khác nhau" trên thực tế lại đang nắm giữ tỷ trọng lớn vào một số ít công ty trong số đó.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a bubble
segments.tr: ## Lập luận cho rằng đây là một bong bóng

segments.src: Analysts who see froth point to several concerns:
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích nhìn thấy sự sục sôi chỉ ra một số mối quan ngại:

segments.src: - **Spending may outrun revenue.** Companies are investing heavily before it is clear how much customers will pay for AI products. If returns arrive more slowly than hoped, spending could be cut, hitting suppliers hard.
segments.tr: - **Chi tiêu có thể vượt quá doanh thu.** Các công ty đang đầu tư mạnh mẽ trước khi rõ ràng khách hàng sẽ trả bao nhiêu cho các sản phẩm AI. Nếu lợi nhuận đến chậm hơn mong đợi, chi tiêu có thể bị cắt giảm, giáng một đòn mạnh vào các nhà cung cấp.

segments.src: - **Circular deals.** Some critics note that money moves in loops, with companies investing in customers who then buy their products. That can make demand look stronger than it is.
segments.tr: - **Giao dịch vòng tròn.** Một số nhà phê bình lưu ý rằng tiền di chuyển theo vòng lặp, với các công ty đầu tư vào khách hàng, những người sau đó mua sản phẩm của họ. Điều đó có thể làm cho nhu cầu trông mạnh mẽ hơn thực tế.

segments.src: - **High valuations.** When prices assume years of rapid growth, even modest disappointment can cause large drops.
segments.tr: - **Định giá cao.** Khi giá cả giả định nhiều năm tăng trưởng nhanh chóng, ngay cả sự thất vọng khiêm tốn cũng có thể gây ra những đợt sụt giảm lớn.

segments.src: - **Historical echoes.** Comparisons are often made to the late-1990s dot-com era, when real technology change coincided with prices that later proved far too high.
segments.tr: - **Hồi ức lịch sử.** Các phép so sánh thường được đưa ra với kỷ nguyên dot-com cuối những năm 1990, khi sự thay đổi công nghệ thực sự trùng hợp với mức giá sau đó chứng tỏ là quá cao.

segments.src: ## The case that it is a durable shift
segments.tr: ## Lập luận cho rằng đây là một sự dịch chuyển bền vững

segments.src: Others argue that this time rests on firmer ground:
segments.tr: Những người khác lập luận rằng lần này dựa trên nền tảng vững chắc hơn:

segments.src: - **Real profits.** Unlike many dot-com era firms, today's leaders are large, profitable businesses that fund much of their spending from their own cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Lợi nhuận thực tế.** Không giống như nhiều công ty thời kỳ dot-com, các công ty dẫn đầu ngày nay là những doanh nghiệp lớn, có lợi nhuận, tài trợ cho phần lớn chi tiêu của họ từ dòng tiền của chính họ.

segments.src: - **Visible demand.** Cloud providers have reported that demand for computing capacity has at times exceeded supply.
segments.tr: - **Nhu cầu hiển hiện.** Các nhà cung cấp đám mây đã báo cáo rằng nhu cầu về năng lực điện toán đôi khi vượt quá nguồn cung.

segments.src: - **Broad adoption.** Businesses across health care, finance, logistics and software are testing or deploying AI tools, which could raise productivity over time.
segments.tr: - **Sự chấp nhận rộng rãi.** Các doanh nghiệp trong lĩnh vực chăm sóc sức khỏe, tài chính, hậu cần và phần mềm đang thử nghiệm hoặc triển khai các công cụ AI, điều này có thể nâng cao năng suất theo thời gian.

segments.src: - **Technology precedent.** Past general-purpose technologies, such as railroads and the internet, also saw heavy overbuilding, yet reshaped the economy in the long run.
segments.tr: - **Tiền lệ công nghệ.** Các công nghệ đa dụng trong quá khứ, chẳng hạn như đường sắt và internet, cũng chứng kiến tình trạng xây dựng quá mức nặng nề, nhưng cuối cùng đã định hình lại nền kinh tế trong dài hạn.

segments.src: Both camps can be partly right.
segments.tr: Cả hai phe đều có phần đúng.

segments.src: A technology can be transformative and still be overpriced in the short term, and a correction does not mean the underlying change fails.
segments.tr: Một công nghệ có thể mang tính chuyển đổi nhưng vẫn bị định giá quá cao trong ngắn hạn, và một đợt điều chỉnh không có nghĩa là sự thay đổi cơ bản thất bại.

segments.src: ## How this reaches your 401(k)
segments.tr: ## Điều này tác động đến tài khoản 401(k) của bạn như thế nào

segments.src: Most workers do not pick individual stocks.
segments.tr: Hầu hết người lao động không chọn từng cổ phiếu riêng lẻ.

segments.src: They hold target-date funds, index funds or other diversified options in their retirement plans.
segments.tr: Họ nắm giữ các quỹ theo ngày mục tiêu, quỹ chỉ số hoặc các lựa chọn đa dạng hóa khác trong kế hoạch hưu trí của họ.

segments.src: Those funds often track large-cap U.S.
segments.tr: Các quỹ đó thường theo dõi các chỉ số vốn hóa lớn của Hoa Kỳ,

segments.src: indexes, so the concentration described above comes along automatically.
segments.tr: vì vậy mức độ tập trung được mô tả ở trên sẽ tự động đi kèm theo.

segments.src: - **Target-date funds** typically hold a large share of U.S. stocks, which means significant exposure to the same leading companies.
segments.tr: - **Quỹ theo ngày mục tiêu** thường nắm giữ tỷ trọng lớn cổ phiếu Hoa Kỳ, điều này có nghĩa là mức độ tiếp xúc đáng kể với các công ty dẫn đầu tương tự.

segments.src: - **S&P 500 and total market index funds** are weighted by size, so the largest names have the biggest influence.
segments.tr: - **S&P 500 và các quỹ chỉ số toàn thị trường** được tính trọng số theo quy mô, vì vậy các tên tuổi lớn nhất có ảnh hưởng lớn nhất.

segments.src: - **Overlap is easy to miss.** Holding several funds that each track large U.S. companies may increase, rather than reduce, exposure to the same handful of stocks.
segments.tr: - **Sự trùng lặp rất dễ bị bỏ sót.** Nắm giữ một số quỹ mà mỗi quỹ theo dõi các công ty lớn của Hoa Kỳ có thể làm tăng, thay vì giảm, mức độ tiếp xúc với cùng một số ít cổ phiếu.

segments.src: A sharp drop in those leading stocks could therefore show up in a retirement balance even if the investor never bought any of them directly.
segments.tr: Do đó, sự sụt giảm mạnh ở những cổ phiếu dẫn đầu đó có thể xuất hiện trong số dư hưu trí ngay cả khi nhà đầu tư chưa bao giờ mua trực tiếp bất kỳ cổ phiếu nào trong số đó.

segments.src: Younger savers have time to recover from downturns.
segments.tr: Những người tiết kiệm trẻ tuổi có thời gian để phục hồi sau các đợt suy thoái.

segments.src: People close to retirement have less, which is why timing and mix matter.
segments.tr: Những người sắp nghỉ hưu có ít thời gian hơn, đó là lý do tại sao thời điểm và cơ cấu lại quan trọng.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Các điểm thực tế cần xem xét

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic or to try to time the market, which is notoriously difficult.
segments.tr: Không có điều nào trong số này là lý do để hoảng sợ hoặc cố gắng thời điểm hóa thị trường, vốn nổi tiếng là khó khăn.

segments.src: But there are sensible questions to ask:
segments.tr: Nhưng có những câu hỏi hợp lý cần đặt ra:

segments.src: 1. **Check what you own.** Most plan websites list a fund's top holdings. See how much sits in the largest companies.
segments.tr: 1. **Kiểm tra những gì bạn sở hữu.** Hầu hết các trang web kế hoạch liệt kê các khoản nắm giữ hàng đầu của một quỹ. Xem có bao nhiêu nằm trong các công ty lớn nhất.

segments.src: 2. **Look at diversification.** Consider whether your mix includes bonds, international stocks, smaller companies and other areas that do not move in lockstep with big technology.
segments.tr: 2. **Xem xét tính đa dạng hóa.** Cân nhắc xem cơ cấu của bạn có bao gồm trái phiếu, cổ phiếu quốc tế, các công ty nhỏ hơn và các lĩnh vực khác không di chuyển đồng điệu với công nghệ lớn hay không.

segments.src: 3. **Match risk to your timeline.** The closer you are to needing the money, the more a large drawdown can hurt.
segments.tr: 3. **Ghép nối rủi ro với mốc thời gian của bạn.** Bạn càng cần tiền sớm bao nhiêu, thì một đợt sụt giảm lớn càng có thể gây tổn thương bấy nhiêu.

segments.src: 4. **Rebalance periodically.** Strong gains in one area can quietly push your portfolio away from its intended mix.
segments.tr: 4. **Cân đối lại định kỳ.** Lợi nhuận mạnh mẽ ở một khu vực có thể âm thầm đẩy danh mục đầu tư của bạn khỏi cơ cấu dự kiến của nó.

segments.src: 5. **Keep contributing steadily.** Regular contributions over time can smooth out the effect of buying at different prices.
segments.tr: 5. **Tiếp tục đóng góp đều đặn.** Các khoản đóng góp thường xuyên theo thời gian có thể làm mượt mà hiệu ứng của việc mua ở các mức giá khác nhau.

segments.src: 6. **Ask for help if needed.** A licensed financial adviser or your plan's educational resources can help tailor choices to your situation.
segments.tr: 6. **Yêu cầu giúp đỡ nếu cần.** Một cố vấn tài chính được cấp phép hoặc các tài nguyên giáo dục của kế hoạch của bạn có thể giúp điều chỉnh các lựa chọn cho phù hợp với tình hình của bạn.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The AI spending race may prove to be a lasting economic shift, an overextended boom, or some mix of the two.
segments.tr: Cuộc đua chi tiêu AI có thể chứng minh là một sự thay đổi kinh tế lâu dài, một sự bùng nổ quá mức, hoặc một sự kết hợp nào đó của cả hai.

segments.src: No one knows for certain, and confident predictions in either direction deserve caution.
segments.tr: Không ai biết chắc chắn, và những dự đoán tự tin theo bất kỳ hướng nào đều đáng được cẩn trọng.

segments.src: What is clear is that market concentration is high, and that it affects many retirement savers who never chose it.
segments.tr: Điều rõ ràng là mức độ tập trung của thị trường rất cao, và nó ảnh hưởng đến nhiều người tiết kiệm hưu trí chưa bao giờ chọn nó.

segments.src: Understanding what your funds hold is a practical first step, whichever way the story ends.
segments.tr: Hiểu rõ các quỹ của bạn nắm giữ những gì là bước đầu tiên thiết thực, dù câu chuyện kết thúc theo hướng nào.
